posts.instagram:
Your third grader reads every word, then can't tell you what the story was about?

Grade 3 Reading Comprehension Workbook is a reading practice book for third graders. It has 40 reading passages with questions on vocabulary, critical thinking and finding evidence in the text.

Progress trackers help you see how far they've come, and the answer key makes checking work simple. Read a passage together, talk it through, and build from there.

📚 Grade 3 Reading Comprehension Workbook: 40 Reading Passages with Vocabulary, Critical Thinking, Evidence-Based Questions, Progress Trackers, and Answer Key, from Bright Minds Prep
📖 Get it: apexlitpublishinggroup.com/books/17-grade-3-reading-comprehension-workbook/

posts.title: Grandma's Kitchen

video_frames.hook:
Write down
her recipes
while you can.
video_frames.cta: Find it at the link in bio

posts.instagram:
Some recipes were never written down. They live in a pinch of this and a story about who taught her.

Grandma's Kitchen is a family recipe keepsake journal for anyone who wants to save the family's cooking in one place. It has room to record your family recipes and the stories that go with them.

Sit down with Grandma, an aunt or your mom, write it all down together, and make something to pass down through generations.

🍲 Grandma's Kitchen: A Family Recipe Keepsake Journal, from ApexLit Publishing
📖 Get it: apexlitpublishinggroup.com/books/82-grandmas-kitchen/
